Focal announcement: Furthering our AI ambitions – Announcing Bing Chat Enterprise and Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing.

Decision cutoff: 2023-07-18T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Furthering our AI ambitions – Announcing Bing Chat Enterprise and Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing. Published date: 2023-07-18. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2023/07/18/furthering-our-ai-ambitions-announcing-bing-chat-enterprise-and-microsoft-365-copilot-pricing.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Updated November 15, 2023: To simplify the user experience and make Copilot more accessible to everyone, Bing Chat and Bing Chat Enterprise will now simply become Microsoft Copilot. Today at Microsoft Inspire , we’re excited to unveil the next steps in our journey: First, we’re significantly expanding Bing to reach new audiences with Bing Chat Enterprise, delivering AI-powered chat for work, and rolling out today in Preview – which means that more than 160 million people already have access. And, in the future, Bing Chat Enterprise will also be accessible from Windows Copilot. Editor’s note: As of Aug. 21, we have extended Bing Chat Enterprise eligibility to Microsoft 365 A3 and A5 licenses for faculty. Tags: AI , Bing Chat Enterprise , Microsoft 365 Copilot , Microsoft Inspire , Visual Search
